title: ML force-field screening identifies 12 superionic conductor candidates
summary: A symmetry-based search paired with molecular-dynamics calculations using a universal machine-learning force field identified five oxygen-, four lithium- and three sodium-based superionic conductor candidates. The authors report simulated diffusion properties comparable to leading materials and connected diffusion pathways. These are computational predictions; the study abstract does not establish experimental synthesis or measured ionic conductivity.
ai_technology: Universal machine-learning force field for molecular-dynamics screening
